en.headline: Peng Kanglong ink exhibition begins second rotation at Tai Kwun
en.dek: INKstudio’s solo show of nearly 40 works by the contemporary ink artist runs its second rotation from today until 28 November.
body: The second rotation of Peng Kanglong’s solo exhibition Losing My Way to Watch the Flowers Bloom opened today at INKstudio in Tai Kwun, Central, and will continue until 28 November.

The gallery said the show brings together nearly 40 works spanning the artist’s career, including an eleven-metre handscroll and a silver-foil folding screen, alongside monochrome ink pieces and flower-landscape compositions.

Peng, who graduated from the Taipei National University of the Arts in 1988, is known for synthesising the traditionally separate genres of landscape and flower painting, drawing on techniques from late-Ming masters and Huang Binhong.

The exhibition is presented in two rotations; the first ran from 19 September to 21 October. It is on view at Shop 03-104, 1/F, Barrack Block, Tai Kwun, with the gallery typically open Tuesday to Saturday from 11 am to 7 pm.

zh.headline: 彭康隆水墨個展第二階段於大館墨齋展開
zh.dek: 近40件作品的個展「迷路只為看花開」第二輪替今日起至11月28日於中環大館展出。
body: 當代水墨藝術家彭康隆個展「迷路只為看花開」第二階段今日於中環大館墨齋（INKstudio）展開，展期至11月28日。
畫廊表示，展覽匯集藝術家歷年近40件作品，包括長達十一米的水墨長卷、銀箔屏風，以及單色水墨與花卉山水作品。
彭康隆1988年畢業於台北藝術大學水墨組，以融合傳統上分野的山水與花卉畫種見稱，筆法取自明末清初大師及黃峙虹。
展覽分兩階段輪替，第一階段由9月19日至10月21日。場地位於大館營房大樓1樃03-104室，畫廊一般於星期二至六上午11時至下午7時開放。
